Gas Monkey Garage is a world-famous custom car shop based in Dallas, Texas, founded by Richard Rawlings. Known from the hit TV show Fast N’ Loud, the garage builds and restores classic cars with creativity, speed, and attitude.
December 26, 2025 - In 2002, Rawlings launched Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas, selling Lincoln Press in 2004. The shop customizes classic and hot-rod automobiles for customers worldwide.
